states.name: Arrival

states.name: Run
states.note: A flesh bowl; seven mounds of dead flies over the bile. No boss.

states.name: Arrival

states.name: Phase 2
states.note: He eats it all: the mass rises as a spiral of towers; the bile rises; the core tops the climb.

states.name: Arrival

states.note: A whole frozen lake in a bowl. No boss.

states.name: Phase 2

skull.name: Swarm skull
skull.tell: Chatter grows as the flock turns
skull.counter: Stream across the flock, keep moving

attacks.name: bite
attacks.note: the two nearest bites land per tick in the game

versions.note: A loose flock that streams at the player
Tiered swarmer on one shared flock behaviour: separation, cohesion, a bite pause, and per-tier mechanics

Model-first tier 1: a pure function of time and target. The flock mills on a twisted torus round you (the fish-school vacuole); one skull at a time peels off, cuts through the hole to bite, and rejoins its own slot

1.name: Tier 1 · Skull
1.note: Mill, tell (jaw chatter speeds up), strike through the hole. One bite every 0.32 s at most. No weak point

attacks.name: launch
attacks.note: swells (tell), then flies in and pops

worm.name: Skull worm
worm.counter: Shoot the head, sidestep the lunge
worm.weakPoint: A row of orbs along the belly, one per segment; they show as the body rolls.

attacks.name: strike
attacks.note: wraps the player inside 4 m, strikes after 2.5 s

versions.note: BONEPEDE II: flies on its trail, belly weak points, chases, coils and strikes

scorpion.name: Scorpion
scorpion.tell: Plants and scrapes before the charge
scorpion.counter: Sidestep and hit it while it recovers
scorpion.weakPoint: The stinger, but only while it recovers from a charge with its tail down.

spawner.name: Wandering spawner
spawner.weakPoint: The crown mouth, always open: the priority kill.

quadruped.name: Quadruped
quadruped.verb: Stalks on four legs and pounces
quadruped.counter: Back off the pounce line, punish the landing
quadruped.weakPoint: A spine orb that opens on the landing after a pounce.

shooter.name: Shooter
shooter.verb: Keeps its distance and fires dodgeable shots
shooter.counter: Break line of sight, then close in
shooter.weakPoint: The eye, open while it charges a shot.

spider.name: Disc spider
spider.verb: Circles the rim and swallows orbs
spider.tell: Skitter, and its belly glows as it fills
spider.counter: Kill it before ten swallows birth a worm
spider.weakPoint: The two mouths at the front.

censer.name: Censer
censer.verb: Lobs arcs of burning blood that pool
censer.tell: Chain clink as it winds up
censer.counter: Leave the pool, shoot the swinging censer
censer.weakPoint: The coals in the cage, brightest at the top of each swing.

leviathan.name: Leviathan, the Skull Squid
leviathan.verb: Rises from the centre pool and fires rings
leviathan.tell: The pool boils before it surfaces
leviathan.counter: Below half health it fans and spirals; kill the escort worms

diver.name: Diver
diver.tell: A ring on your tier and a falling shriek
diver.counter: Change tier. Stepping sideways is not enough
diver.weakPoint: Its back, while it lies stunned after a dive.

percher.name: Percher
percher.verb: Holds the high perches and fires down
percher.weakPoint: An eye on top of its head: get above it.

belphegor.name: Belphegor
belphegor.verb: Hangs at the top tier and sweeps the lowest
belphegor.tell: Its sweep line crawls across a tier first
belphegor.counter: Weak points show only from above
belphegor.weakPoint: Three on its top: only reachable from above.

sentinel.name: Statue sentinel
sentinel.verb: Walks you down, and takes damage only from behind
sentinel.tell: Stone grind, and its eyes light when it turns
sentinel.counter: Flank it, or jump-pad over it
sentinel.weakPoint: Its back. It turns slowly, so flank it.

zealot.name: Zealot
zealot.verb: Shields the enemies near it and chants bolts
zealot.tell: Chanting, and a halo on the shielded

belial.name: Belial
belial.verb: Shielded on the dais until humbled
belial.tell: A pillar glows while it feeds the shield
belial.counter: Break his four pillars, then he walks the gallery
belial.weakPoint: The face, dim until the four pillars fall.

maggot.name: Maggot
maggot.verb: Eats corpses and grows a size each time
maggot.counter: Kill it while it is small, clear corpses

bloater.name: Bloater
bloater.verb: Spits bile arcs, then bursts in a cloud
bloater.counter: Kill it at range, away from the crowd

beelzebub.name: Beelzebub
beelzebub.verb: He is the swarm: kill the flock to expose the core
beelzebub.tell: The swarm tightens round the core
beelzebub.counter: He eats his own horde to grow; keep the flock thin
beelzebub.weakPoint: The core inside the swarm, which shows as the swarm reaches for you.

imp.name: Imp thief
imp.verb: Snatches orbs and credits, then flees
imp.counter: Chase it down and the loot drops back

gilded.name: Gilded skull
gilded.counter: Break the plating, then the core. It pays big
gilded.weakPoint: The core, when the shell vents or the plates are gone.

versions.note: The Gilded skull prototype rig: volley, vent, plates

mammon.name: Mammon
mammon.verb: Steals the mana orbs into his hoard
mammon.counter: Break the hoard to take them back; then dash the locked lifts

twins.name: Twins
twins.verb: Move as a pair. Kill one and the other enrages

siren.name: Siren
siren.verb: Sings a pull beam that drags you in
siren.tell: A rising note, and the screen tints
siren.counter: Break line of sight or dash out
siren.weakPoint: The throat, open while it sings.

lilith.name: Lilith
lilith.verb: Charms and pulls from the high petals
lilith.counter: Shoot only while her mirror is down
lilith.weakPoint: The heart, while her mirror is down.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.verb: Grows faster as it takes damage
berserker.counter: Burst it down, never chip it

orobas.name: Orobas
orobas.verb: Sweeps a beam across the arena
orobas.tell: The beam line shows before it fires

amon.name: Amon
amon.verb: Jailer on the top block, beam sweeps
amon.tell: Keys rattle as the yard floods
amon.counter: Climb with the fire; the cells open on phase two

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.verb: Poses as a mana orb or pickup, then bites
mimic.tell: The orb shimmers wrong and does not bob
mimic.weakPoint: Inside the mouth when it opens.

liar.name: False prophet
liar.verb: Casts decoy copies of itself and fires from one
liar.tell: Only the real one casts a shadow
liar.weakPoint: The chest of the real one, the copy with a shadow.

quire.name: Quire, the clerk
quire.verb: Writes clauses that rewrite the arena
quire.tell: The quill scratches before a clause lands
quire.counter: Read the contract; the mirrors become the real arena

traitor.name: Traitor
traitor.verb: Frozen in the ice, thaws behind you
traitor.counter: Shatter the frozen ones before they thaw

lancer.name: Ice lancer
lancer.verb: Throws freezing lances. A frozen player slides
lancer.counter: Keep moving, and use the slide

companion.name: The Companion
companion.counter: The lake cracks into floes; keep your footing
companion.weakPoint: Not shown yet: a story beat.
